## What is the current behavior?
<!-- Please describe the current behavior that you are modifying, or link to a relevant issue. -->

Issue Number: #37149

In the current behavior, if you import a module with an event plugin
before `BrowserModule`, then this plugin will never be found. This is
because `DomEventsPlugin` is the only plugin that supports all events and
it will be in front of the plugin that was imported.

# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report

### Description
Hi,
Order of import HammerModule cause that hammer.js not working

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

### What's the affected URL?
https://angular.io/api/platform-browser/HammerModule

### Reproduction Steps**
Repo: https://github.com/Anderies/gesture-angular
File: src/app/app.module.ts
```
 imports: [
    HammerModule,
    // Move up HammerModule
    BrowserModule,
    AppRoutingModule,
    // SHOULD BE IMPORTS AT ANGULAR 9
  ],
```

### Expected vs Actual Behavior**
When you move import above then hammer.js not working. This should be included in the documentation.

Ubuntu 20.04

issue.body:
This fixes the issues when `BrowserModule` is not the first module imported.

I choose not to introduce a specific token for the `DomEventsPlugin` as this would likely be breaking. 

Fixes #37149 #37850
